cohort: The study participants were pregnant women who delivered at Bhumibol Adulyadej Hospital in Thailand between January 2017 and December 2024.
finding: The prevalence of pre-eclampsia with severe features (sPE) was 17.8 per 1,000 deliveries, and factors such as previous preeclampsia, chronic hypertension, diabetes, illicit drug use, advanced age, BMI >=25, and familial history of hypertension were significantly associated with a higher risk of sPE development.
